name: Ahoah
overview: The name Ahoah appears in the genealogical records of the tribe of Benjamin, specifically noted as a descendant among the sons of Bela. Scripture identifies Ahoah with variations such as Ahiah and Ira, reflecting common ancient practices of name variation or alternate naming within families. These references in 1 Chronicles 7 and 8 highlight Ahoah's place within the lineage of mighty men and heads of families, underscoring the importance of genealogical heritage in God's providential plan.
